Quantinuum has expanded its partnership with Japan’s research institute RIKEN to accelerate the commercialization of quantum‑AI hybrid supercomputing within the country. The collaboration aims to integrate Quantinuum’s quantum computing capabilities with RIKEN's advanced AI and data‑processing infrastructure, targeting applications in scientific research, industrial optimization, and national computational resources. This effort is intended to establish Japan as a leading hub for next‑generation high‑performance hybrid quantum–classical systems.
